text:
Windows DWM Blur & Glass Customizer is a free, open-source Windows desktop customization utility that brings Aero Glass, Acrylic, Mica, and advanced blur effects to system title bars. Personalize your Windows 10 and Windows 11 desktop with configurable transparency, colors, and visual effects through an easy-to-use graphical interface — no command line required.

 ⬇️ Installation

 Download the Windows application 

1. Open the repository's Releases page.
2. Download the latest release archive Windows DWM Blur & Glass Customizer 4.4.5.zip .
3. Extract the archive into a folder of your choice.
4. Keep Windows DWM Blur & Glass Customizer 4.4.5.exe and libvlc.dll together in that folder.
5. Double-click Windows DWM Blur & Glass Customizer 4.4.5.exe to launch the application.

 ✨ Features

- 🌫️ Global DWM Blur Effects — Customize Desktop Window Manager blur effects to give Windows applications a modern translucent appearance.
- 🪟 Aero Glass Transparency — Bring back the classic Windows Aero-inspired glass appearance with configurable blur and transparency.
- 🎨 Acrylic Material Effects — Apply translucent Acrylic-style materials with adjustable visual characteristics.
- 🧊 Windows 11 Mica Support — Enable Mica and Mica Alt-inspired title bar effects on compatible Windows 11 systems.
- 🌈 Custom Title Bar Colors — Adjust title bar blending, foreground text colors, and appearance settings to match your desktop theme.
- 🌗 Automatic Light and Dark Modes — Configure appearance behavior for different Windows color modes.
- ⚙️ Advanced DWM Customization — Fine-tune blur methods, visual parameters, and additional title bar appearance options.

 🖼️ Overview

 

 Supported Visual Effects

 Effect Description Compatibility 
 --- --- --- 
 Aero Classic glass-inspired transparency Windows 10 / 11 
 Blur Customizable background blur Windows 10 / 11 
 Acrylic Modern translucent material Windows 10 / 11 
 Mica Windows 11-inspired backdrop Compatible Windows 11 builds 
 Mica Alt Alternative Mica appearance Compatible Windows 11 builds 

Actual effect availability depends on your Windows build, rendering method, and system configuration.

 Desktop Customization Possibilities

- Customize the appearance of global system title bars.
- Adjust blur intensity and visual blending.
- Configure title bar background and foreground colors.
- Experiment with different transparency styles.
- Create consistent appearances across supported applications.
- Combine Windows personalization settings with compatible third-party themes.

 🚀 Usage

1. Install the application using the official release package.
2. Launch the graphical interface to access available Desktop Window Manager customization options.
3. Choose a visual effect such as Blur, Aero, Acrylic, or Mica.
4. Adjust appearance settings including colors, blur parameters, and theme behavior.
5. Apply your configuration and inspect the updated Windows title bar appearance.
6. Fine-tune your desktop until the selected effect matches your preferred visual style.

 🖥️ Windows Compatibility

The application is designed for modern Windows desktop environments.

 Platform Support 
 --- --- 
 Windows 10 Supported 
 Windows 11 Supported 
 Windows 11 Mica Supported on compatible builds 
 Third-party Windows themes Compatibility depends on the theme 
 Older Windows versions Not guaranteed 

 Important: Some effects depend on Windows rendering capabilities and may behave differently between operating system builds. Certain Windows Insider releases may introduce compatibility limitations.

 🎨 Customization Options

 Blur and Transparency

Explore different blur approaches to achieve the appearance you want:

- Custom blur configurations.
- Accent-based blur appearance.
- System backdrop effects.
- Adjustable blur intensity.
- Custom title bar blending.

 Title Bar Appearance

Personalize the details that make your Windows desktop unique:

- Custom background colors.
- Configurable title bar text colors.
- Light and dark appearance settings.
- Windows 7-inspired title bar button styling.
- Additional visual refinements for supported applications.

 Third-Party Theme Compatibility

The customization approach is designed to complement Windows personalization and supported third-party desktop themes.

Compatibility with other DWM customization utilities can vary. Avoid enabling multiple tools that modify the same system rendering components simultaneously.

 🔒 Security & Privacy

Your desktop customization software should be transparent and trustworthy.

- Open source: Review the available source code and understand how the application works.
- No telemetry: No intentional analytics, usage tracking, or telemetry functionality is required for its core operation.
- No account required: Desktop customization does not require creating an online account.
- Official downloads: Obtain executable packages from the project's official GitHub Releases page.
- Report vulnerabilities: Submit suspected security problems through the repository's private security reporting feature when available. For ordinary bugs, use GitHub Issues.

 Download safety: Avoid repackaged executables and unofficial download mirrors. Verify that release assets originate from the project's official distribution channel.

 System modification notice: DWM customization interacts with Windows desktop rendering components. Create a restore point before experimenting with advanced system-level appearance modifications.

 🛠️ Technical Details

 Component Details 
 --- --- 
 Application type Native Windows desktop utility 
 Primary technology C++ 
 Graphics integration Desktop Window Manager (DWM) 
 Main purpose System title bar customization 
 Target operating systems Windows 10 and Windows 11 
 Interface Graphical desktop interface 

The project focuses on customizing system-level visual presentation rather than requiring individual application developers to modify their programs.
